Match that exact construction scale, line weight and matte hand-painted game illustration. Do not make a photorealistic metal object, 3D sculpted render or modern electronic chip.

Not another square seal: its distinguishing structure is a small shallow bronze frame containing two or three flat jade comb/slit leaves, staggered like a tiny adjustable ritual gate, with a clearly recognizable central narrow passage. Everything lies horizontally FLAT, seen from exact 90-degree orthographic TOP VIEW. The body is low profile and slightly clipped-cornered, a functional handmade formation part. Use only a few strong broad silhouettes, not miniature dense ornament.
Exactly TWO functional terminal collars: a small muted CINNABAR signal inlet at the WEST edge midpoint and matching CINNABAR signal outlet at the EAST edge midpoint. Both are aligned on the same horizontal central axis. A short dark-red inset path can show inside the little gate, but all red stops within the part; leave no outgoing wire in the transparent margin. The top and bottom edges are CLOSED with no socket, colored notch or fake contact. The bronze frame around each terminal is shallow and simple; terminal mouths visibly face outward, suitable for a separate thin line to enter.
This is a signal condition gate that passes already-matching events. Its imagery must NOT imply an energy source, battery, elemental effect, shield, switch requiring two simultaneous events or numeric counter. No clock face, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, CPU pins, electronic plugs, external wires, backdrop slab, board, UI, cells or grid.
Square native canvas. Entire component centered, filling roughly 78-84% of the canvas width and similar height, with true transparent alpha background and clean safety margin around the complete silhouette. NO cast ground shadow or halo outside the object. Strong readable icon at 64px. Keep the component compact in the same physical scale as the reference array eye; make the comb/gate silhouette distinct enough to distinguish it from a seal, trough, fork or paired protective plates.
